Hi Ari — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO/financials. I9ve looped in Monica from Finance and Marcus (sales lead) so we can run this through the credit review quickly.

Short answers up front:
- Net60 is above our standard approval band for new accounts of this size, but it9s not impossible with additional credit checks.
- We can offer a provisional Net45 with a $300k credit line within 48 hours if Zenwell can sign a short payment addendum and provide two trade references.
- Alternatively, we can accept Net60 for the full $500k if Zenwell agrees to a 25% advance against the attached PO and a 90-day credit review cadence.

Next steps I propose:
1) Monica will send our credit application and a short template addendum to formalize terms.
2) If you want faster approval without an advance, please forward two trade references (AP contact and average monthly spend with a vendor).
3) We can set a quick 20-minute call tomorrow to finalize which path works for you.

Goal is to avoid interrupting your rollout — we9ll prioritize this.

If it helps, we can also accept a signed payment addendum agreeing to monthly invoices and a 45-day review cadence; that lowers the internal approvals needed.

Thanks — I9ll follow up with the provisional decision as soon as checks complete.
